title: Admin Portal Search, Filters & Timed Assessment Isolation (v0.4.42)
message: Fixed School Directory and Student Account search/filter controls, and isolated classroom weekly quizzes from division timed tests.
changelog:
🛠️ ADMIN PORTAL & ASSESSMENT ISOLATION UPDATE v0.4.42:
• School Directory Search & District Filtering: Restored real-time campus search and District 1 / District 2 chip filtering across all 25 junior high schools.
• Student Credential Vault Filters: Restored instant search by learner name, username, or LRN, alongside Grade, Class Section, Account State, and Campus scoping filters.
• Division Timed Assessment Isolation: Strictly separated classroom weekly quizzes from standardized division timed tests in SDO Super Admin view.
